title: The Hall That Would Not Open
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：function　|　正文 408 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 function 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The new hall in our town was finished in November and did not open until March, which everyone blamed on the roof and which was really the fault of a door. The building's ① function, the architect kept saying, was to hold four hundred people; its ② function in practice, for the first four months, was to keep the rain off a stack of chairs. A hall that will not open has no function at all, whatever the drawings say.

I was seventeen and had a holiday job carrying things. My ③ function was officially to move chairs and unofficially to stay out of the way, which are the same job described by two different people. The site manager, Mrs Osei, had a different ④ function again: to decide, every morning, which of the two hundred remaining faults mattered. She was very good at it and completely unsentimental.

The door was the last fault. It was a sliding thing made in another country, and it did not ⑤ function below four degrees. In December it stuck shut; in January it stuck open; in February it ⑥ functioned as a very expensive hole in the wall. The manufacturer's report said the mechanism was within tolerance, which is what a report says when a thing works in a factory and not in a town.

Mrs Osei's own solution was a wooden panel fitted inside the frame for six weeks. It ⑦ served a function nobody thanked her for, cost ninety pounds, and was removed the day the real door was fixed. She walked twelve miles a day across that site and said the only ⑧ function she trusted completely was her own knees. She also told me something I have never forgotten: a thing's function is not what it was designed to do but what it is trusted to do, and trust is a kind of engineering too. The roof, he had explained, is a ⑨ function of the span: double the span and you do not double the steel.

The hall opened in March with a concert. Four hundred people came, and the door behaved. There was a ⑩ function afterwards in the small room upstairs, with speeches about the town and none at all about the door, which I thought unfair. Every function I have organised since — a wedding, two funerals, one meeting about a bus route — has been judged by the same rule Mrs Osei used: did the thing open, and did anybody get in.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 功能；作用；用途
B. n. 职责；职能；（某人的）任务
C. v. 运转；工作；起作用
D. v. 充当；起……的作用（function as）
E. n. 正式集会；典礼；宴会
F. 固定搭配：serve a function 起到某种作用
G. n. （数学的）函数（a function of）

items.q: My function was officially to move chairs
it did not function below four degrees
it functioned as a very expensive hole in the wall
It served a function nobody thanked her for
the only function she trusted completely was her own knees
is a function of the span
There was a function afterwards in the small room

answers.why: 建筑师图纸上写的“功能”：容纳四百人。
实际上的“作用”只是给一摞椅子挡雨，与设计意图形成对照。
指“我”的“职责、任务”，正式说法是搬椅子。
同样指职责，工地负责人的职能是每天判断哪些毛病要紧。
动词，意为“运转、工作”，门在四度以下就不工作。
function as 意为“充当、起……的作用”，此处说门成了墙上一个昂贵的洞。
serve a function 意为“起到某种作用”，说那块木板起了作用却没人谢她。
指身体的“机能、官能”，她唯一完全信得过的是自己的膝盖。
a function of 是数学用法，意为“……的函数”，此处说屋顶用钢量随跨度变化。
function 作名词指“正式集会、典礼”，此处是楼上的招待会。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 这座建筑的功能是容纳四百人。（function）
我的职责正式说来是搬椅子。（function）
那道门在四度以下就不工作。（function v.）
二月里，它充当了墙上一个非常昂贵的洞。（function as）
屋顶是跨度的函数：跨度翻倍，用钢量不止翻倍。（a function of）
楼上的小房间里 afterwards 还有一个招待会。（function n.）
answers: The function of the building is to hold four hundred people.
My function was officially to move chairs.
The door did not function below four degrees.
In February it functioned as a very expensive hole in the wall.
The roof is a function of the span: double the span and you do not double the steel.
There was a function afterwards in the small room upstairs.
